english.note: Use this idiom for an unwanted or uninvited visitor, especially when the emphasis is on their unwelcome arrival.

examples.english: We had just sat down to eat when an intruder showed up at the door.
examples.traditional: 我哋啱啱坐低食飯，不速之客就上門喇。
